defects.summary: TodoWrite (granted to the conductor by C001-IF-09 A0 and assumed by C001-TS-221) is absent on Opus 5.x in Claude Code >= 2.1.268; TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList replace it and appear only when the session sets CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 (verified 2.1.295, C001-T-030)
defects.resolution: C001-REQ-219, C001-TS-221, C001-IF-09 A0 and C001-IF-10 section 3 revised for the task tools (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.summary: C001-REQ-206/TS-207 require 2-3 options with the first labelled (Recommended) for every optioned question, but C001-REQ-802/TS-802 require the gate question to offer exactly Approve, Approve with waivers, Revise and Stop; the gate question needs an explicit exception (four fixed options, no recommendation) (found in C001-T-034)
defects.resolution: C001-REQ-206 and C001-TS-207 except the gate question of C001-REQ-802 (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.summary: C001-TS-602, 611, 615, 617, 619 and 620 say 'the lint checks/parses' plan artifacts (task file shape, TC fields, risk fields, rollout content, handoff headings, ordered task list) but C001-IF errors catalogue defines no rule codes for them; verified for now by structure checks in the integration tests (found in C001-T-043)
defects.resolution: Codes LINT-TASK-004, LINT-TC-001, LINT-RISK-001, LINT-ROLL-001, LINT-HAND-001, LINT-HAND-002 added to the error catalogue and named in TS-602/611/615/617/619/620; implementation planned as C001-T-076 (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.summary: C001-REQ-1013 has the conductor write serena/serena_config.yml in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, but the conductor's write scope and the path guard (C001-REQ-1101, GUARD-PATH-001) allow writes only under .sdd/; implemented as a named exception for that one file (found in C001-T-044)
defects.resolution: C001-REQ-1013 now runs sdd serena-config (C001-IF-01); implementation planned as C001-T-077 (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.summary: C001-REQ-813 needs the IDs added, modified and removed since the last approval and their downstream references, but C001-IF-01/IF-13 define no CLI output for it; implemented as an Impact block of sdd gate show for phases in revision (found in C001-T-044)
defects.resolution: C001-IF-13 section 1 documents the two impact lines of sdd gate show for a phase in revision (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)
